G0001G	α, Ἀλφα	Alpha	Alpha	Α, α, ἄλφα (which see), τό, indecl., \n alpha, the first letter of the Greek alphabet. As a numeral, ά = 1, α = 1000. An intensive force (LS, s. α), as in ἀ-τενίζω is sometimes assumed (but see Boisacq, see word).\n (AS)
